selection_notes: Times are Perfetto nanoseconds. CPU/device timestamps are not rebased.
Launch flow selects work; temporal GPU overlap is not ownership. Display lanes are not CUDA streams.
Loss setup begins at end of GFSDP::post_forward (mtp.layers.0); folded hidden/label setup and fp32 GradAccumulator allocation are included.
Gather is prefetched during MTP forward. Gather-to-bridge enclosing elapsed includes remaining MTP computation and is only a broad guard.
CE per outer chunk includes main and MTP compiled forward, normalization/weights, inner CE backward, and SplitBackward cat. Head forward/backward GEMMs stay outside CE.
Chunk CPU spans include root callbacks walking all modules and gradient accumulation copies; callbacks are not exclusively lm_head.
Backward heads execute in reverse graph order. No head-index claim is based on timestamps alone.
FLCE computes dinput/dweight within custom-op forward; comparison must use whole outer chunk plus gather and final accumulation/cast guard.
No candidate traces or speedup/numerical conclusions.
